description.p: Collabora Office brings the familiar Collabora Online experience to your computer - so you can create, edit, and present with a beautiful, modern UI. Built on LibreOffice, it delivers excellent interoperability with ODF and Microsoft Office formats (DOCX/XLSX/PPTX), and exports to PDF with ease. Your documents stay on your device unless you choose to share them - privacy by design.
New features and fixes in this release:

ul.li: Built-in AI assistant across Writer, Calc and Impress – draft and refine text, fix formulas, fact check slides, without leaving your work
Smarter editing – document comparison and multi-page view in Writer, calculated pivot fields and per-user views in Calc
Ever improving document compatibility – improved handling of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint formats
More accessible – a broad set of accessibility improvements throughout
More reliable clipboard – copy and paste in and out of Collabora Office
